actions_english.prompt:
Respond with detailed but simple instructions in English. Each line must consists of only one action, where the mentioned objects must be items from the following list: ['chicken leg', 'cabinet right door', 'cabinet left door', 'cabinet', 'stove on the left', 'stove on the right', 'counter top on the left', 'counter top on the right', 'pot lid', 'pot body', 'pot bottom', 'stove knob on the right', 'stove knob on the left', 'kitchen sink', 'faucet handle', 'fridge', 'fridge door', 'fridge shelf', 'salt shaker', 'pepper shaker'].

    Currently, you can see the following objects: ``the pot lid is on the stove on the left,
the pot body is on the counter top on the right,
the chicken leg is on the fridge shelf,
the salt shaker is in the cabinet,
the pepper shaker is in the cabinet,
cabinet right door is partially open,
cabinet left door is partially open,
fridge door is partially open,
stove knob on the right is turned off,
stove knob on the left is turned off,
faucet handle is turned off''
Use the following contexts for creating your action sequence:
Once you've made the basic chicken soup below, you divide the broth & meat, then add different ingredients to get endless combinations.
Make the basic chicken soup & freeze in portioned containers; then add the ingredients for individual recipes below to make a quick, tasty soup on a busy night.
Bring all ingredients just to boil in large pot.
Skim off foam & discard.
Reduce heat & simmer, uncovered, 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is very tender.
Cool soup completely before freezing or refrigerating, preferably by placing the pot in a sink of ice and stirring.
The pot should be uncovered while it is cooling.
In the Kitchen Basic chicken soup begins with a broth made by cooking the chicken with savory vegetables (such as onions, carrots, and celery) and herbs (usually sage, thyme, bay leaf and parsley).
From the basic stock, you can vary your soup by adding your favorite vegetables, pasta or rice.
Drizzle the top of each bowl with a tablespoon of garlic mayonnaise and a tablespoon of the basil cream.
Pass the remaining mayonnaise and basil cream at the table.
SUGGESTIONS AND VARIATIONS Almost any vegetable soup can be turned into a chicken soup by poaching pieces of chicken in the simmering soup about 15 minutes before serving.
actions_english.response:
Open fridge door.
Take chicken leg from fridge shelf.
Place chicken leg on counter top on the right.
Open cabinet left door.
Take salt shaker from cabinet.
Place salt shaker on counter top on the right.
Open cabinet right door.
Take pepper shaker from cabinet.
Place pepper shaker on counter top on the right.
Take pot body from counter top on the right.
Place pot body on stove on the left.
Take pot lid from stove on the left.
Place pot lid on counter top on the right.
Turn stove knob on the left.
Place chicken leg in pot body.
Turn faucet handle.
Fill pot body with water from kitchen sink.
Place pot lid on pot body.
Turn stove knob on the left to maximum heat.
Wait until water boils.
Reduce heat by turning stove knob on the left.
Simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until chicken is very tender.
Turn off stove knob on the left.
Place pot body in kitchen sink.
Fill kitchen sink with ice and water.
Stir pot body to cool down the soup.
Wait until soup cools down completely.
Remove pot body from kitchen sink.
